synopsis: The booklet uses “draft,” “under publication” and “under revision” to flag standards not issued by October 2026; these labels distinguish pending text from published requirements [f46, f1200, f9419]. ISO 21815-4, covering swing and rotation, is listed at stage 60.00 (“Under publication”) for October 2026, but one chapter explicitly leaves its final publication status uncertain; its scope excludes avoidance by automatic brake application [f1708, f2059, f5074, f7543]. ISO/PRF 21815-5 reached proof stage in September 2026, remained at proof stage in October, and was expected to publish in November 2026, covering motions including articulation and reversing trailers [f323, f6025, f6026, f6747]. All five ISO 19014 parts were reported under publication for October 2026, shortly before design verification would freeze, but another chapter lists revised ISO 19014-1 for 22 November 2026, leaving a scheduling discrepancy [f48, f12000, f7738]. For virtual-validation planning, ISO/PAS 34506 remained unfinished and road-vehicle-specific, and no developing off-road scenario standard was found that could arrive before mid-2027 [f3746, f7695, f7206].
